aws:requesttag/${tagkey}.description: Filters access based on the tags that are passed in the request

aws:resourcetag/${tagkey}.description: Filters access based on the tags associated with the resource

aws:tagkeys.description: Filters access based on the tag keys that are passed in the request

iam:awsservicename.description: Filters access by the AWS service to which this role is attached

iam:accountpropertynamespaces.description: Filters access by the account property namespaces being read or modified

iam:associatedresourcearn.description: Filters access by the resource that the role will be used on behalf of

iam:delegationduration.description: Filters access based on the requested delegation duration

iam:delegationrequestowner.description: Filters access based on the delegation request owner

iam:enableidentitycenterassociation.description: Filters access by whether the request associates an IAM Identity Center instance with an IAM identity provider (true) or removes the association (false)

iam:enableidentitypropagation.description: Filters access by whether the request adds (true) or removes (false) a context provider on an IAM identity provider

iam:fido-fips-140-2-certification.description: Filters access by the MFA device FIPS-140-2 validation certification level at the time of registration of a FIDO security key

iam:fido-fips-140-3-certification.description: Filters access by the MFA device FIPS-140-3 validation certification level at the time of registration of a FIDO security key

iam:fido-certification.description: Filters access by the MFA device FIDO certification level at the time of registration of a FIDO security key

iam:notificationchannel.description: Filters access based on the requested notification channel

iam:organizationspolicyid.description: Filters access by the ID of an AWS Organizations policy

iam:passedtoservice.description: Filters access by the AWS service to which this role is passed

iam:permissionsboundary.description: Filters access if the specified policy is set as the permissions boundary on the IAM entity (user or role)

iam:policyarn.description: Filters access by the ARN of an IAM policy

iam:registersecuritykey.description: Filters access by the current state of MFA device enablement

iam:requestidentitycenterinstancearn.description: Filters access by the ARN of the IAM Identity Center instance in the request

iam:requestidentityproviderissuers.description: Filters access by the issuer values in the request: the issuer URL without the https:// prefix for OIDC providers, or a lowercase hex SHA-384 hash of each signing certificate's DER SubjectPublicKeyInfo for SAML providers

iam:resourceidentitycenterinstancearn.description: Filters access by the ARN of the IAM Identity Center instance associated with the existing IAM identity provider in the request

iam:resourceidentityproviderissuers.description: Filters access by the issuer values of the existing IAM identity provider in the request: the issuer URL without the https:// prefix for OIDC providers, or a lowercase hex SHA-384 hash of each signing certificate's DER SubjectPublicKeyInfo for SAML providers

iam:resourcetag/${tagkey}.description: Filters access by the tags attached to an IAM entity (user or role)

iam:roletemplatearn.description: Filters access by the role template ARN used in the request

iam:servicespecificcredentialagedays.description: Filters access by the duration until the credential's expiration

iam:servicespecificcredentialservicename.description: Filters access by the service associated with the credential

iam:templatearn.description: Filters access based on the requested template ARN
